We thank you for your interest in the Dubai International Growth Initiative. A specialist will review your information and contact you.

For an expedited review process, please have the following documents prepared in either physical or digital format:

  • Shareholding details, including active interest in the business.
  • Trade License.
  • Memorandum of Association (MOA).
  • Business Plan.
  • Audited Financial Statements (or last 6 months' bank statements if audited financials are not available).
  • Financial Projections.
  • AECB Credit Report.
  • Legal agreements with international partners or locations, if applicable.

The Dubai International Growth Initiative is the first of its kind, offering financing solutions based on the Emirates’ Interbank Offered Rate (EIBOR), with no additional margin to accelerate the global expansion of Dubai-founded SMEs.

The first phase of the initiative is open to Dubai-founded SMEs in sectors including E-commerce, food and beverage (F&B), fast moving consumer goods (FMCG), manufacturing, services and retail (including parts and machinery) with additional sectors to be added in subsequent phases.
